trust_decision.summary: Decided in UrlSanitizer::parse(): a URL is dropped (null) when it carries explicit-direction BiDi formatting marks or, after the fix, any Unicode whitespace / zero-width no-break space, either raw or percent-encoded in user, pass, host, path, query or fragment; the surviving value is emitted as an href/src attribute.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the URL parser's deny gates; the only existing deny gate in the tree is the BiDi regex at line 104 inside UrlSanitizer::parse(), the single place where a URL is rejected for the characters it contains.

fix_sites.module_kind: component text sanitizer (internal value-level URL parser)

fix_sites.entry_point: Same public surface, plus direct calls to the public static UrlSanitizer::parse() (exercised by provideParse); the added loop runs after UriString::parse() over user, pass, host, path, query, fragment
fix_sites.module_kind: component text sanitizer (internal value-level URL parser)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No out-of-scope site and no uncovered route exist, so there is no dismissal argument for a solver to make about this advisory's own mechanism.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Percent-encoded ASCII space in the path/query must stay accepted (it is percent-encoded by the parser, not denied), as must percent-encoded NUL, percent-encoded non-ASCII in the host, raw fullwidth/IDN hosts and raw non-ASCII paths; a fix that decodes and then rejects on \s, \p{C} or 'any non-ASCII' breaks these accepted cases at test lines 526, 533, 601-606 and 638. The deny list must also stop short of U+200B/U+2060 and U+2025, which the fix leaves allowed. Separately, the pinned suite still asserts the old permissive expectations for the two U+FEFF URLs at lines 542 and 600, so a correct fix turns two existing tests red.

O6_input_shapes: raw denied character in the URL string (U+00A0, U+2028, U+2029, U+3000, U+205F, U+FEFF, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069)
denied character placed in any of the six components: user, pass, host, path, query, fragment
ASCII space left in path/query/fragment, which the parser percent-encodes and keeps instead of denying

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second sanitizer for srcset candidate lists that splits on commas, strips descriptors and re-applies the same deny gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: srcset is allowlisted as a safe attribute (src/Symfony/Component/HtmlSanitizer/Reference/W3CReference.php:373) but is not in this sanitizer's attribute list, so a maintainer hardening URL attributes could add a sibling sanitizer instead of extending the existing one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a host-only deny gate placed next to decodeUnreservedCharacters(), decoding %XX in the host and rejecting denied characters there
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: that private method already exists because the host needs its own decoding rule, so a maintainer could put the host case beside it rather than in a six-component loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: routing forced attributes through the URL deny gate before they are written onto the node
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: forced attributes skip every attribute sanitizer by design, and a maintainer who treats forced href values as attacker-influenced would add the gate at exactly this call.

O9_family: Unicode visual spoofing / underinclusive deny list (BiDi formatting marks, homoglyphs, whitespace in rendered URLs)

O10_build.toolchain: composer (league/uri ^6.5|^7.0, masterminds/html5 ^2.7.2) + PHPUnit via the component phpunit.xml.dist
O10_build.project_tests: src/Symfony/Component/HtmlSanitizer/Tests/TextSanitizer/UrlSanitizerTest.php with the provideSanitize and provideParse data providers (several hundred URL cases); HtmlSanitizerAllTest / HtmlSanitizerCustomTest; suite declared in src/Symfony/Component/HtmlSanitizer/phpunit.xml.dist

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend only the raw-character regex at UrlSanitizer.php:104 with Unicode whitespace, or put the decoded check in UrlSanitizer::sanitize() next to the scheme/host policy, leaving UrlSanitizer::parse() - which the fix's own tests call directly through provideParse - still open to percent-encoded input.

unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell available in this session); the component directory is small but the symfony/symfony tree is large, so giant_repo could not be ruled in or out.

O1 counted as 1: the Twig sanitize_html filter (src/Symfony/Bridge/Twig/Extension/HtmlSanitizerExtension.php:32), the Form PRE_SUBMIT option (src/Symfony/Component/Form/Extension/HtmlSanitizer/Type/TextTypeHtmlSanitizerExtension.php:62-67) and HtmlSanitizerInterface::sanitize()/sanitizeFor() all reach the flaw but only delegate to the same one function, so no separate change site exists; counting them literally would give O1 = 3-4.

O12 single_site: the fix has two hunks (raw gate replaced at fix.diff:78-84, decoded loop added at fix.diff:93-97), but both live in UrlSanitizer::parse() and the decoded component loop also rejects the raw characters (raw denied chars survive UriString::parse and rawurldecode leaves them unchanged; raw tab/newline are already caught by preg_match('/\s/', $url)), so either hunk alone passes every case the fix adds - treated as effectively one place.
